nodes.description: Internal function of ModuleProxyFactory that validates a non-zero target and deploys a minimal proxy bytecode using CREATE2 through inline assembly.
Public function that derives a salt from the initializer, deploys a proxy via createProxy, and then invokes the proxy with the supplied initializer calldata.
Address parameter of createProxy: implementation address embedded in the proxy creation code.
Bytes32 salt parameter of createProxy used as the CREATE2 salt.
Local memory variable holding the concatenated proxy bytecode (prefix, target, suffix).
Return local variable of createProxy holding the address returned by the CREATE2 assembly call.
Inline assembly CREATE2 opcode call that deploys the proxy deterministically from arbitrary bytecode.
Address parameter of deployModule naming the master copy implementation to be used as the proxy target.
Arbitrary bytes parameter of deployModule used both for salt derivation and as proxy initialization calldata.
Uint256 nonce parameter of deployModule mixed with the initializer hash to produce the CREATE2 salt.
Local/return variable holding the address of the newly deployed proxy.
Local boolean capturing the success flag returned by the low-level call to the proxy.
Low-level external call proxy.call(initializer) executed before the ModuleProxyCreation event is emitted, allowing reentrant execution.

edges.reason: deployModule invokes createProxy to deploy the proxy contract.
masterCopy is forwarded as the target argument to createProxy.
initializer is hashed and used to derive the salt passed to createProxy.
saltNonce is combined with the initializer hash to build the CREATE2 salt passed to createProxy.
target is abi.encodePacked into the deployment bytecode payload.
salt is supplied as the salt operand of the assembly create2 call.
the deployment bytecode is passed to create2 as init code.
the address produced by create2 is assigned to the result return variable.
the freshly deployed proxy address is the target of the low-level call.
the caller-controlled initializer bytes are sent as calldata to the low-level call.
the success flag is the boolean returned by the external call invoked by deployModule.
proxy.call executes attacker-influenced external code that can reenter deployModule before the ModuleProxyCreation event is emitted.
